title: Saved UTC payload traffic charts
scope: A chart is added above each existing saved-history table. Daily remains the default.
The chart consumes the already accepted immutable saved result; it makes no new reads or requests.
Daily contains 24 UTC hourly buckets; 7 days contains exactly seven oldest-to-newest UTC daily buckets.
Only payload download and payload upload are drawn. All six original counter domains remain in the existing tables.
Values are signed byte counts for each bucket, never transfer rates, interpolated estimates or a combined weekly total.

values.integer_domain: Signed 64-bit integers, including negative adjustments and observed zero.
values.daily: Optional saved hourly counters; an absent snapshot or hour is unknown.
values.seven_days: Optional member daily total; a missing file or a present day without observations is unknown.
values.unknown: A gap in both traces, not a fabricated zero.
values.zero: An actual known point on the zero axis.
values.connection: Only adjacent known buckets connect; isolated known buckets have a visible marker.
values.arithmetic: Rendering uses finite floating coordinates without signed integer subtraction or absolute-value overflow; original raw integers remain exact.

presentation.legend: Payload download and upload use distinct colors and line styles.
presentation.tooltip: Nearest bucket with literal plain text UTC identity and exact signed integer values; unknown explicitly labeled.
presentation.accessibility: Accessible period and byte-unit description; all raw bucket facts retained.
presentation.layout: Plot height is bounded to 180–260 logical pixels. Narrow views use sparse or elided tick labels; the table remains resizable and scrollable.

lifecycle.binding: Existing nonzero session/request/date and Ready-result admission applies unchanged.
lifecycle.clearing: Pending, missing, failed, new-date and new-profile results clear plotted known values.
lifecycle.hidden: Views retain accepted immutable packets but defer chart facts, tooltip, labels and model mutation until visible and not minimized.
lifecycle.reentry: The plot update precedes the table update. QPointer and revision checks stop older work after callback deletion or a newer frame.

original_source_reference.differences: Original History plots two payload directions using the selected period and current clock, with pixel merging and integer display scaling. Fixed UTC hourly/daily saved buckets do not claim original rolling-graph, clock-clamping, width-mapping, legend-interaction or UI runtime parity.

equality_scope.limits: Existing corpus comparisons cover numeric saved-period totals only. No presence, strict-error, current-clock, live-writer, global-owner or original UI equality is added.
